annotation_scope.input: One immutable public ClinicalTrials.gov criterion plus the frozen split concept catalog.
annotation_scope.output: One literal ATOM, ALL, ANY, or NOT expression tree under the frozen annotation schema.

atom_rules.fact_selection_all: Use all only when the source explicitly requires a universal condition across repeated facts.
atom_rules.fact_selection_any: Use any for history, ever, or any-occurrence conditions.
atom_rules.fact_selection_latest: Use latest for current or most-recent conditions.
atom_rules.negation: Represent source negation as NOT around a positive-fact atom; do not encode negation as expected boolean false.
atom_rules.operator: Use only the comparator stated by the source; do not strengthen or relax a boundary.
atom_rules.range: Represent an explicit closed or open range as ALL of its stated lower and upper bound atoms.

condition_id_rules.format: Use <criterion_id>:aNN with two-digit numbering starting at a01.
condition_id_rules.ordering: Assign numbers by each atom's left-to-right source-span order; ties retain expression traversal order.
condition_id_rules.stability: Do not renumber based on normalized tree order.

criterion_semantics.exclusion: The expression is true when the exclusion condition described by the source is present; do not invert it into an eligibility-safe condition.
criterion_semantics.inclusion: The expression is true when the inclusion condition described by the source is satisfied.
criterion_semantics.literal_tree: Encode the literal condition stated by the criterion, not the final patient eligibility decision.

expression_rules.and: Use ALL when the source explicitly requires all connected conditions, including explicit both.
expression_rules.or: Use ANY when the source explicitly allows alternatives, including explicit either.
expression_rules.unclear_scope: Do not infer grouping or operator scope that the source does not make clear; route it through the unrepresentable policy.

independence_rules.single_annotator_mode: The frozen owner-approved downgrade applies; the result is single-annotator reference gold and has no IAA or adjudication claim.
independence_rules.validator_role: A validator may report schema or contract failures but may not suggest semantic repairs.

provenance_rules.method: Every atom uses human provenance and the current criterion source ID.
provenance_rules.source_span: Select the smallest continuous source substring that supports the complete atom, including comparator, value, unit, negation, and time language when present.

time_rules.limitation: Calendar months and years are approximated as fixed day counts because schema 1.0.0 stores integer days; this limitation is permanent for benchmark version 1.0.0.

unrepresentable_policy.annotation_draft: Leave expression null while the item remains unresolved.
unrepresentable_policy.completion_gate: A completed annotation cannot contain an unresolved item; the owner must resolve it under the frozen schema or approve a schema and guide revision before annotation resumes.
unrepresentable_policy.issue_record: Record the criterion ID, exact ambiguity or unsupported construct, and resolution in a separate owner-review issue log; do not force a tree.
